articles.title: Spotify Running Mode helps match tunes to tempo
articles.summary: Spotify has introduced a new Running Mode feature that makes it easier to curate playlists around your workout goals, music tastes, and desired BPM.
articles.body: Spotify has introduced a new Running Mode feature that makes it easier to curate playlists around your workout goals, music tastes, and desired beats per minute (BPM). The aim is to help you “spend less time hunting for the right music and more time moving,” according to Spotify’s announcement, providing customizable running presets and optional coaching features. [Image: The feature looks similar to the regular Spotify mobile app UI, but with some additional running-focused information and customization options. Running Mode is an AI-powered experience that builds on personalization capabilities that were introduced with Prompted Playlists last year, with Spotify finding that fitness-based prompts have been some of the most popular uses for that feature. It requires a Premium subscription and can be found under the Fitness hub that Spotify launched in April. It’s available starting today on Spotify’s iOS app, but only for users in the US, UK, Canada, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Sweden for now. There are 25 curated running playlist presets to choose from, which can be further customized around your preferred music genres, workout duration, BPM, and training method — including interval, steady, and pyramid. Running Mode also includes optional audio prompts in English that provide “timely cues and motivation without getting in the way of your music,” according to Spotify. This isn’t the first experience that Spotify has made specifically for runners. It launched a Spotify Running feature in 2015 that was also designed to help you match music to your running pace, before retiring it in 2018. There is a notable distinction between that and the new Running Mode, however — Spotify Running used your phone hardware to automatically detect your pace and react by playing music that synchronizes with it, whereas Running Mode needs you to proactively define your own workout playlist requirements from the start.

articles.title: Post Malone’s Engagement Ring for Fiancée Christy Lee Boasts a Whopping Diamond Weighing 20-Plus Carats
articles.summary: Malone popped the question with a massive sparkler designed by Angel City Jewelers
articles.body:
Post Malone is engaged to stylist Christy Lee

The singer popped the question with a massive diamond engagement ring boasting over 20 carats

Experts previously predicted to PEOPLE the whopping price tag of Lee's new rock, which could be in the millions

Post Malone had some help from his jeweler in designing the perfect engagement ring for his fiancée Christy Lee .

The "Circles" singer, 31, got engaged to Lee earlier this month. The news was announced through Lee's friend Marina Hollyer, who shared photos of the couple, including one of the bride-to-be flashing her giant diamond engagement ring , to her Instagram Stories on Aug. 19.

Now, Malone's jeweler is sharing the details behind the mega sparkler, which weighs over 20 carats, according to Isaac Bokhoor and Sam Tack's Angel City Jewelers .

"Blessed to have been able to work on this for my brother @postmalone What a project !" the company wrote on Instagram alongside photos and videos of the dazzling ring, which features a stone set on a gold band.

It's no surprise that the duo was the final choice for Malone, who has worn Angel City custom pieces, including his Dallas Cowboys diamond-encrusted pendant necklace (which TMZ reported to be worth $250,000 in 2019), throughout his career.

But before details of Lee's ring were confirmed, PEOPLE spoke with experts about the ring's possible price tag.

While the official price has yet to be disclosed, Olivia Landau, founder of The Clear Cut, now part of Blue Nile , says the rock might have a price tag that's close to $1 to $2 million. Ali Galgano , founder of New York and Greenwich-based fine jewelry house Serpentine Jewels , even went as far as pricing the ring at a whopping $2.5 million .

"We've seen so many celebrity engagement rings lately that are about unusual cuts, antique stones or really distinctive settings," Galgano said. "This one feels almost like a throwback to the great celebrity engagement rings of the 2000s — the enormous center stone, the classic solitaire setting, and absolutely no attempt to be understated. It's unapologetically a big-diamond engagement ring, and there's something fun about seeing that kind of maximalism again."

Malone, born Austin Post, and Lee were first linked after they were spotted together in March 2025. A month later, the pair were seen going to dinner at high-end steakhouse Beefbar in Paris. Days later, the pair stepped out for a shopping spree in Paris.

Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories.

The news of their relationship came amid speculation that Malone and his former fiancée, Hee Sung "Jamie" Park , had split. The former couple were engaged in 2021, after the "Finer Things" singer popped the question in Las Vegas, he confirmed in a 2023 interview with Alex Cooper's Call Her Daddy podcast . In May 2022, he revealed that he and Park were expecting their first child together .

Lee is a fashion stylist and creative director, according to her website , and she attended Parsons School of Design in New York City. It's not known how she and Malone met.

articles.title: Cerâmica Kadiwéu feita com barro da terra ganha espaço em Bonito | G1
articles.standfirst: Peças são produzidas de forma artesanal, com materiais retirados da natureza, e fazem parte de nova marca criada para ampliar a comercialização dos produtos indígenas
articles.summary: Peças são produzidas de forma artesanal, com materiais retirados da natureza, e fazem parte de nova marca criada para ampliar a comercialização dos produtos indígenas
articles.body:
Artesãs Kadiwéu levam tradição e cerâmica ao Festival de Bonito — Foto: Antônio Bispo

Do barro retirado da própria terra às peças moldadas e queimadas no fogo, a arte das mulheres Kadiwéu ganhou espaço no Festival de Inverno de Bonito (MS). Pela primeira vez, um grupo de artesãs participa do evento para apresentar e vender cerâmicas produzidas dentro do Território Indígena Kadiwéu, em Porto Murtinho .

Entre as expositoras está Neilce Bernaldino da Silva, que cresceu convivendo com as artesãs e hoje participa do processo de recuperação da produção de cerâmica em sua comunidade. Segundo ela, o trabalho começou a ser retomado no ano passado e reúne mulheres das aldeias Tomázia, Alves de Barro e Campina.

“É um privilégio muito grande de podermos estar aqui vendendo. Nossa venda está sendo um sucesso”, contou.

O processo para transformar o barro em uma peça começa ainda na natureza. As artesãs retiram a matéria-prima dentro do próprio território indígena e fazem todo o trabalho manualmente.

Depois de moldadas, as peças não são levadas a fornos industriais. A queima é feita diretamente com fogo.

“É muito trabalhoso, desde a coleta do barro até a queima. Nossas peças são queimadas com fogo, não com forno”, explicou Neilce.

Até as cores usadas nas peças vêm da natureza. Segundo a artesã, não são utilizadas tintas compradas. Os próprios tipos e tonalidades do barro são aproveitados para criar os desenhos e acabamentos.

“Todos os materiais são da natureza. Até as tintas também são da natureza, do próprio barro. A gente não compra nenhum tipo de tinta”, disse.

A técnica também carrega uma história que atravessa gerações. O conhecimento é ensinado principalmente dentro das famílias, passando de mãe para filha.

A intenção das artesãs é manter essa tradição viva e ensinar o trabalho às próximas gerações.

“Futuramente, nosso foco é passar para os nossos filhos, os netos”, afirmou Neilce.

A participação no festival também marca o lançamento de uma nova marca criada para reunir e dar maior visibilidade aos produtos Kadiwéu.

A Godidiko reúne cerâmicas, camisetas e bolsas com grafismos tradicionais. A proposta é aproximar os produtos de novos compradores sem deixar de lado os conhecimentos e a identidade cultural das comunidades.

O lançamento ocorreu na sexta-feira (28), no Espaço de Economia Criativa do festival. Cerca de seis artistas Kadiwéu apresentaram parte do catálogo desenvolvido durante o projeto.

As artesãs permanecem no espaço durante o Festival de Inverno, onde expõem e comercializam os produtos.

A criação da marca é resultado de um trabalho desenvolvido ao longo de oito meses, com atividades de qualificação da produção, orientação sobre apresentação dos produtos e preparação para novos mercados.

Para Madalena, da Aldeia Tomázia, as capacitações ajudaram a ampliar a produção de peças.

“Eu só tenho a agradecer aos nossos caciques, líderes e aos professores que nos ensinaram”, afirmou.

Para Elenilda, também da Aldeia Tomázia, estar no festival tem um significado ainda maior por representar a comunidade em um espaço diferente das aldeias.

“Pela primeira vez vou sair para representar a comunidade em um espaço como esse. É uma honra representar as mulheres ceramistas”, disse.

A participação no Festival de Inverno representa uma nova etapa para as artesãs, que agora conseguem apresentar o trabalho para pessoas de diferentes lugares e ampliar as possibilidades de venda.

O Território Indígena Kadiwéu fica em Porto Murtinho e tem cerca de 538 mil hectares. O local reúne conhecimentos tradicionais, grafismos e uma produção de cerâmica marcada pelas técnicas e características próprias do povo Kadiwéu.

O trabalho de fortalecimento do artesanato é desenvolvido pela Wetlands International Brasil e pela Mupan – Mulheres e Lideranças pelas Áreas Úmidas, organizações que atuam com o povo Kadiwéu desde 2015. Desde 2017, a iniciativa também integra ações do Programa Corredor Azul.

A ideia é ajudar as artesãs a alcançar novos espaços de comercialização, mas mantendo a identidade e os conhecimentos tradicionais presentes em cada peça.

O Festival de Inverno de Bonito começou na quarta-feira (26) e segue até domingo (30), com atrações gratuitas espalhadas por diferentes pontos da cidade. Além do artesanato e da economia criativa, a programação reúne música, teatro, dança, literatura, exposições e outras manifestações culturais.

Neste sábado (29) , a principal atração é Seu Jorge, que sobe ao Palco Sol com um repertório que mistura samba, soul, MPB e funk.

No domingo (30) , Humberto & Ronaldo encerram o festival com sucessos do sertanejo universitário.

As artesãs Kadiwéu também permanecem no festival neste fim de semana, com exposição e venda das peças produzidas no território indígena.

articles.title: Festival Mundo Asiático reúne K-pop e gastronomia em Praia Grande | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento tem entrada gratuita e segue até domingo (30), com gastronomia oriental, apresentações culturais, cosplay e tributos musicais.
articles.summary: Com entrada gratuita, o Festival Mundo Asiático em Praia Grande reúne gastronomia oriental, concursos de cosplay e apresentações de K-pop até este domingo.
articles.body:
O festival acontece em Praia Grande (SP) e reúne atrações populares do oriente. — Foto: Divulgação

O Festival Mundo Asiático começou nesta sexta-feira (28), em Praia Grande , no litoral de São Paulo, com mais de 100 opções de pratos, apresentações culturais e atrações ligadas à cultura pop asiática. O evento tem entrada gratuita e segue até domingo (30).

A programação acontece das 10h às 23h, no estacionamento do Espaço Alvorada. Segundo a organização, mais de 70 expositores participam do festival.

Entre as opções gastronômicas estão pratos das culinárias japonesa e coreana, além de outras especialidades orientais. O público encontra receitas como sushi, ramen, kimchi e tteokbokki.

A proposta, segundo os organizadores, é aproximar o público de diferentes aspectos das culturas asiáticas, que ganharam espaço no Brasil por meio da gastronomia, da música e de outras manifestações da cultura pop.

K-pop, cosplay e apresentações culturais

Além da gastronomia, o festival tem apresentações de dança, kung fu e dança do dragão, além de atividades relacionadas a anime, cosplay e K-pop.

Neste sábado (29), estão previstos Random Play Dance, apresentações das Guerreiras K-POP, participações de personagens como Pikachu e Sonic e um concurso de cosplay. As inscrições para a competição são feitas no próprio local.

No domingo (30), a programação terá novas apresentações de K-pop, duas sessões de Random Play Dance, concurso de cosplay e tributos musicais a BLACKPINK e Bruno Mars.

articles.title: Festival da Farinha: Tapioca com mais de 1 metro vence concurso no AC | G1
articles.standfirst: Produtor José Roberto Oliveira fez tapioca com 1,02 metro de diâmetro e ficou em 1º lugar na sexta (28), em Cruzeiro do Sul. Festividade termina neste sábado (29).
articles.summary: Produtor José Roberto Oliveira fez tapioca com 1,02 metro de diâmetro e ficou em 1º lugar na sexta (28), em Cruzeiro do Sul. Festividade termina neste sábado (29).
articles.body:
🍽️ A terceira e penúltima noite do 9º Festival da Farinha em Cruzeiro do Sul , no interior do Acre, ocorrida na última sexta-feira (28), foi marcada pelo concurso da maior tapioca . A competição reuniu produtores que precisaram preparar o prato regional que faz sucesso na mesa do acreano, mas sem quebrar a massa.

O grande vencedor foi o produtor José Roberto Gomes de Oliveira, da comunidade Ramal do Japãozinho, localizada na zona rural do município. Ele fez uma tapioca com 1,02 metro de diâmetro e recebeu R$ 2 mil.

"Essa premiação representa muita coisa para mim, porque vai me ajudar a construir minha casa. A gente fica muito nervoso na hora de virar, porque quanto maior a tapioca, maior é a dificuldade. Mas quando ela solta do forno e começa a rodar, é o momento certo", disse.

As competições fazem parte da programação do Festival da Farinha e buscam valorizar os produtores e a cadeia produtiva da mandioca no município. Na quinta (27), o morador da Comunidade Ramal 2, José Nascimento, foi o vencedor da mandioca mais pesada, com 31,9 quilos.

Produtor rural recebeu R$ 2 mil e usará o prêmio para construir sua casa — Foto: Foto: Prefeitura de Cruzeiro do Sul

De acordo com o secretário municipal de Agricultura, Abastecimento e Pesca, Nildson Moura, os concursos também são uma forma de incentivar os produtores a melhorar a produção. O festival termina neste sábado (29), com a premiação do concurso da Melhor Farinha.

Conforme a prefeitura municipal, o primeiro colocado da última noite deve receber no total, R$ 4 mil, além dos prêmios destinados ao segundo e terceiro lugar. Durante as quatro noites de festa, o festival reuniu produções audiovisuais e curta-metragem produzidas por alunos de escolas públicas.

Além dos concursos da maior tapioca, na segunda noite do evento também foram eleitos o Rei e a Rainha do Festival da Farinha. Neste ano, Ricardo Caetano, de 21 anos, e Tácila Negreiros, de 22, foram os vencedores da disputa, que reuniu 16 candidatos.

Os vencedores deste ano receberam R$ 5 mil cada, além de celulares e uma Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH). Já o título de princesa ficou com Otávia Gomes e o título de Príncipe foi conquistado por Raul Rocha. Ambos receberam R$ 2,5 mil cada um.

articles.title: Obra de Oscar Niemeyer é reinaugurada no alto de São Vicente | G1
articles.standfirst: Mirante na Ilha Porchat passou por 14 meses de revitalização. Inaugurada em 2002, estrutura faz referência aos 500 anos da chegada dos portugueses ao Brasil.
articles.summary: Mirante na Ilha Porchat passou por 14 meses de revitalização. Inaugurada em 2002, estrutura faz referência aos 500 anos da chegada dos portugueses ao Brasil.
articles.body:
Monumento dos 500 Anos foi projetado por Oscar Niemeyer — Foto: Prefeitura de São Vicente / Ag. O Globo

O Monumento dos 500 Anos, projetado pelo arquiteto Oscar Niemeyer, foi reinaugurado em São Vicente , no litoral de São Paulo, após 14 meses de obras de revitalização.

Localizado no alto da Ilha Porchat, o monumento funciona como mirante e oferece uma vista panorâmica da Ilha de São Vicente. Segundo a prefeitura, as intervenções começaram em junho de 2025 e incluíram nova iluminação, reforma dos banheiros, pintura e instalação de um novo piso.

Os acessos ao monumento e a organização do trânsito no entorno também passaram por mudanças.

Na reinauguração, o espaço ganhou uma placa em homenagem a Oscar Niemeyer. Nela, foi reproduzido um texto do arquiteto explicando a concepção da obra, criada em referência aos 500 anos da chegada dos portugueses ao Brasil, completados em 2000.

"A ideia foi assinalar, com este pequeno monumento, a chegada dos portugueses ao Brasil. Qualquer coisa que contasse na paisagem, lembrando aos visitantes aquele acontecimento", diz trecho do texto de Niemeyer reproduzido na placa.

Inaugurado em 2002, o monumento foi projetado como um mirante voltado para o mar. De acordo com a prefeitura, a estrutura foi posicionada de forma a apontar para uma linha imaginária em direção ao Congresso Nacional, em Brasília (DF).

articles.title: Taylor Swift donates USD 50,000 to a Connecticut resident after a car accident while trying to help teenagers
articles.summary: Taylor Swift comes to the aid of a Connecticut mother, Ashley Taunton, donating $50,000 after she sustained injuries trying to help teenagers involved in a car crash in Rhode Island. Swift's generosity highlights her continued commitment to supporting individuals in need.
articles.body: Over the years, Taylor Swift has continued to give back to the community. From donating to charities to visiting cancer patients and spending time with them, the singer frequently helps people in need. In a recent report, it was revealed that Swift donated a large sum of money to a mother injured after trying to help people who had been in a car accident.Taylor Swift donates a large sum to an injured momPEOPLE reported that the ‘Opalite’ singer recently donated USD 50,000 to Ashley Taunton, a resident of Connecticut. The woman had been injured after she had attempted to help teenagers who had been caught in an accident on a rainy day in Rhode Island. The amount was donated by the singer on the woman’s funding page, which had been set up by her family in order to cover the cost of her recovery expenses.The mother of three and a certified nursing assistant had been with her daughter, driving in Rhode Island, when she spotted that there had been an accident in front of her. While talking to the outlet, she had stated, “When I see there’s somebody in trouble, I tend to want to go help. She further shared that while talking to the teenagers that were involved in the accident, she had asked her daughter to call her father.In the meantime, as she was trying to understand what had happened, another car, whose driver lost control reportedly because of the wet and slippery roads, came straight towards her. Taunton recalled the event and shared, “It just felt like a big explosion. I just remember being on the ground, and I could see my ankle was just hanging there. I went to try to get up, and I couldn’t breathe.” At the time, she had also pushed a teenager out of the way to save him.Taylor Swift donated to the 42-year-old who was trying to help some teenagers who had swerved their car off the road because of the rain. This is not the first time that Swift has donated money to people in need.In 2015, she donated USD 50,000 to an 11-year-old Swiftie who had been fighting leukaemia. At the time, the funding page had a limit of USD 15,000 for every single donation; however, after the ‘Love Story’ singer’s donation, the limit was raised. Similarly, in 2019, Trinity Foster, another fan who had been battling stage four osteosarcoma, had a funding page set up by her family. Swift donated the full USD 10,000 amount of the goal and wrote a sweet note for her fan as well, which read, “I saw photos of your album release party that you did in your hospital room and wanted to say thank you for being so kind and supportive! I hope I can give you a hug in person soon, but in the meantime I wanted to send you this and all my love. Your friend, Taylor.” In 2020, after reading about the plight of two mothers trying to pay rent in the middle of the COVID-19 pandemic, the singer donated USD 13,000 each to them in order to help them out.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Dolly Parton wanted a quiet funeral for her final send-off. But left a few surprises for years to come.
articles.summary: The Grand Ole Opry will honor her Saturday, and Tennessee moves to rename Nashville's airport in her name. Here's what we know about plans to remember her.
articles.body:
Dolly Parton, the beloved "Queen of Country," died Aug. 25 at 80 after "bravely facing a brief battle with cancer," her publicist said .

President Trump ordered U.S. flags flown at half-staff through Sept. 1, while Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee instructed state flags to be lowered, as tributes poured in for one of America's most admired cultural figures.

On Friday, Lee and the Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority announced they intend to rename Nashville International Airport in Parton's honor. The airport authority will take up the proposal at its Sept. 17 meeting. Parton's team told Lee they were "touched by the idea and open to continuing the conversation," according to a statement from the governor's office.

Parton's funeral will be limited to immediate family, in accordance with her wishes, her family said. Elsewhere, plans are taking shape to commemorate her life and legacy more publicly.

Here's what we know about plans to remember her.

A date has not yet been confirmed for the funeral. The family statement announcing her death noted only that "a small, private service will be held for immediate family," per her wishes. No public memorial has been announced.

Parton told Entertainment Weekly in 2014 that she expected Whitney Houston's cover of her song "I Will Always Love You" to be played.

She also said she wanted the hymn "If We Never Meet Again" to be sung. Parton had long wanted the country-gospel hymn, previously recorded by Elvis Presley, to be part of her funeral, saying that it was her father's favorite.

"It's an old country-gospel church song that talks about, 'If we never meet again this side of heaven, I will meet you on that beautiful shore,'" she said. "That was my daddy's favorite. We did sing it at his funeral, and I would like it to be sung at mine."

Parton will be buried beside her husband of 59 years, Carl Dean, at Woodlawn Memorial Park and Mausoleum in Nashville, Katie Couric Media reported. The cemetery is also the final resting place of Dean's parents and several country music legends and friends of Parton, including collaborator Porter Wagoner.

In the Instagram post announcing her death, Parton's nephew and longtime head of security, Bryan Seaver, detailed her request for a comfortable final resting spot. "Dolly called me and said she wants to rest in a beautiful bed of plush cotton, because after a life of wearing heavy rhinestones, she finally deserves to be comfortable and have some rest," Seaver said.

She is, however, expected to wear her signature high heels, TMZ reported.

While the funeral is set to be private, Parton's official channels are inviting fans to tag @DollyParton on social media and share their memories, or leave a message on her website .

In lieu of flowers, the family has asked that donations be made to Dolly Parton's Imagination Library , the book-gifting program for children she founded in honor of her father.

Several other efforts are also underway to honor the Queen of Country's legacy, including some arranged by Parton herself.

In 2015, Parton left behind a musical time capsule: an unreleased song titled "My Place in History," sealed inside a chestnut "Dream Box" on display at Dollywood's DreamMore Resort.

The box is not scheduled to be opened until Jan. 19, 2046, on what would have been Parton's 100th birthday. She spoke about it publicly over the years, joking to The Kelly Clarkson Show that the wait "bothered" her and that she wished she could dig it up early.

Alongside her musical legacy, Parton's philanthropic projects that she built over many decades will outlive her. A spokesperson confirmed on the day of her death that her Imagination Library program, which has distributed more than 300 million books to children, will continue. "The work ahead has never felt more meaningful, and we will carry it forward as she lifts us all up," the project said.

Dollywood temporarily closed Tuesday to mourn its founder, but plans to continue operating. In an Instagram statement, park president Eugene Naughton said it will carry forward her values of kindness and "dreaming big," adding that her presence remains "alive and well" there.

The Grand Ole Opry, where Parton was a member for nearly 60 years, will dedicate its Saturday night show to her. The sold-out tribute runs at 7 p.m. CT and will be livestreamed on the Opry's Facebook and YouTube channels. Carly Pearce, who began her career at Dollywood, is among the artists set to perform. A portion of ticket sales will go to the Imagination Library.

In Parton's home state of Tennessee, one lawmaker said he would float designating Sept. 25 as "9 to 5 Day," a nod to the title of her hit song. Legislators had proposed erecting a statue of Parton in 2021, but she asked them to withdraw the measure, saying she didn't feel comfortable being "put on a pedestal" while she was still alive, though she left open the possibility later on.

The Nashville International Airport push, first started by fans in a change.org petition in January 2025, gained official backing Friday morning when Lee and airport CEO Doug Kreulen announced the proposal. The petition had passed 160,000 signatures by Friday night.

The name change would make Parton the first woman honored on one of America's 50 busiest airports, according to the Associated Press. However, it is not automatic. The airport authority's current policy requires that people it honors have been dead for at least two years, and its board will address both the policy and Lee's proposal at its Sept. 17 meeting. Nashville Mayor Freddie O'Connell called the idea "wonderful."

Parton's manager, Danny Nozell, said that the singer also greenlit a number of projects before her death, including a biopic, a docuseries, a scripted series, an avatar show, a documentary about her upcoming Broadway musical and an animated series inspired by her children's book Billy the Kid .

Parton's goddaughter, Miley Cyrus, said she might turn to songwriting to process the loss. While the details of their closest moments would remain private, "Dolly would want me to feel it, write a song about it, and then continue on and be strong," she said in a tribute on Instagram.

articles.title: Taylor Swift donates $50K to heroic mom who nearly died saving teens from horror car crash
articles.summary: "Wishing you the best recovery possible and sending love to your family!" Swift wrote alongside her generous donation, signing the message simply, "Taylor."
articles.body:
Taylor Swift has donated $50,000 to a GoFundMe benefiting Ashley Taunton , a 42-year-old certified nursing assistant from Connecticut who suffered life-threatening injuries after stopping to help a group of teens on a rain-soaked highway last month.

"Wishing you the best recovery possible and sending love to your family!" the "Cruel Summer" singer, 36, wrote alongside her generous donation, signing the message simply, "Taylor."

Taunton was driving on I-95 South in Rhode Island with her youngest daughter on July 18 when she spotted three teenagers who had been involved in an accident after their vehicle hydroplaned during a severe rainstorm.

"When I see there's somebody in trouble, I tend to want to go help," Taunton told People of her decision to pull over.

She left her daughter safely inside her vehicle and approached the teens, who were a "little bit banged up" from the crash.

However, as Taunton attempted to help move the group out of harm's way, another vehicle lost control on the wet roadway and came barreling toward them.

Taunton managed to push one of the teens out of the vehicle's path before she was struck herself.

Taunton suffered a number of devastating injuries, including multiple fractured ribs, a ruptured diaphragm, internal bleeding and injuries to her liver and spleen.

She was rushed to Rhode Island Hospital, where she began what could be a year-long recovery process that includes extensive physical therapy.

In a shocking twist, Taunton later discovered that one of the teenagers whose life she helped save was Vinny, the son of her longtime friend Jamie O'Rourke.

Taunton recalled that her friend "just lost it" upon learning who had come to her son's rescue.

"Oh my gosh, that was Ashley? She saved my son's life," Taunton recalled O'Rourke saying.

"She was so courageous to put herself in danger," O'Rourke separately told local outlet WPRI.

A GoFundMe was subsequently launched to help Taunton, her husband, Joe, and their three children with expenses while she recovers.

Swift's $50,000 contribution became the fundraiser's largest individual donation.

The Grammy winner has become well known for opening her wallet to people and organizations in need over the years, frequently making sizable donations to food banks, disaster-relief efforts and fans facing financial hardships.

The frightening ordeal, meanwhile, has given Taunton a new perspective on life.

The mom said she is grateful to be alive and has learned not to take her time with loved ones for granted as she faces the long road to recovery.

articles.body: Actor Lee Yong-joo has passed away suddenly at the age of 44, reportedly after suffering a heart attack. The unexpected news has left fans and colleagues shocked and saddened.Lee Yong-joo was best known for playing the role of rookie soldier Lee Yong-joo in the tvN series The Blue Tower. His death was announced on social media on August 29 by a close acquaintance, who also shared a photo of the actor’s funeral altar, as reported by Sports Chosun.The acquaintance confirmed the actor’s passing while remembering him following the tragic news.“I hope this post reaches everyone who knew my dearest friend, actor Lee Yong Joo. Even as I write this, I still cannot believe it,” the acquaintance wrote.They added, “Actor Lee Yong Joo brought laughter to many people as the awkward but lovable rookie soldier Lee Yong Joo in tvN’s The Blue Tower. He suddenly passed away from a heart attack this morning, August 29.”Family and friends struggle to come to terms with his sudden deathLee Yong-joo’s family and close friends were reportedly devastated and struggling to come to terms with his sudden death.The acquaintance explained that because the death occurred unexpectedly, news of his passing had not yet reached many people outside the family and a small circle of close acquaintances.“Because this happened so suddenly, the obituary has not yet reached anyone beyond the family and a few close acquaintances. His phone was locked, and since it is the weekend, his family is also having a very difficult time dealing with the sudden situation,” they said.The acquaintance also made a heartfelt appeal to those who knew the actor.“If anyone reading this knew Yong Joo, please share this news widely so it can reach them,” they said.They also paid an emotional tribute to the late actor, writing, “My dear friend Yong Joo, who was always on my side. I still cannot believe you are gone. Please rest peacefully there without any worries. We will definitely meet again.”Lee Yong-joo had previously spoken about his heart conditionFollowing news of Lee Yong-joo’s sudden death, his previously disclosed heart condition has also come back into focus.During a 2013 interview related to The Blue Tower, the actor explained why he had been exempted from mandatory military service.“I was exempted because of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, a rare disease. I underwent a physical examination and was granted an exemption,” he said at the time.Lee Yong-joo also revealed that his mother had been hospitalized with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and that doctors had warned the condition could potentially be inherited.“My mother was hospitalized with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The hospital said there was a high chance it could be inherited, so my sister and I were tested. I was the only one who had the same condition as my mother,” he said.Lee Yong-joo’s funeral arrangementsLee Yong-joo’s funeral altar has been set up in Room 5 of the funeral hall at Bundang Jesaeng Hospital.His funeral procession is scheduled for 6:30 a.m. on August 31, after which he will be laid to rest at the Seongnam City Funeral Culture Center.Lee Yong-joo’s acting careerLee Yong-joo began his acting career in 2005 with the MBC drama Hello, Franceska.He later appeared in projects including Princess Hours, Saint Valentine and Ugly Miss Young-ae.However, he became widely recognised for his role as the struggling Private Lee Yong-joo in tvN’s The Blue Tower. His portrayal of the awkward yet lovable rookie soldier helped him leave a memorable impression on viewers.His sudden death at the age of 44 has prompted an outpouring of grief from those who knew him and audiences who remember his work on television.

articles.body: TRICHY: The annual feast of St Mary’s Nativity commenced in Velankanni in Nagapattinam district on Saturday with the ceremonial hoisting of the festival flag. At least four devotees were injured as some helium balloons exploded due to fire near the church.The festival began with a procession carrying the festival flag towards the Shrine Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health. Around 6.45 pm, Bishop L Sagayaraj of Thanjavur diocese blessed the flag and hoisted it on the flag mast near the church amid a sea of thousands of devotees.During the hoisting, church staffers burst firecrackers and skyshots. Suddenly some of the stray crackers fell over the helium balloons floating near the flag mast, causing them to explode into a large fireball. The explosion caused panic and tension for several minutes.At least four devotees—Kalaiselvan, Ramesh, Richard and Vijay—were injured on their faces, hands and bodies. They were given first aid and rushed to Nagapattinam Government Medical College Hospital.Nagapattinam MP V Selvaraj, district collector K J Praveen Kumar, rector C Irudayaraj and parish priest J Augustine were also present during the event.Finance minister N Marie Wilson, housing and urban development minister B Rajkumar and chief whip R Sabarinathan represented the state govt.Central Zone IGP V Balakrishnan, Thanjavur range DIG Ziaul Haque and Nagapattinam SP Kelkar Subhramanya Bhalchandra made the necessary security arrangements.Over a million devotees are expected to visit during the 11-day celebration, which concludes with flag lowering on Sept 8. articles.title: Tom Cruise Announces “Days of Thunder” Sequel Will Also Star Anne Hathaway, Marking Their First Time Working Together
articles.summary: The new movie will be a follow-up to the 1990 racing drama that first paired Cruise with Nicole Kidman
articles.body:
Tom Cruise and Anne Hathaway will star in a Days of Thunder sequel

Cruise reprises his role as NASCAR driver Cole Trickle, while Hathaway plays a team owner and engineer

The film, directed by Jonathan Levine, is set for IMAX release on June 2, 2028

Tom Cruise is revving up the engines for another sequel, this time with Anne Hathaway 's help.

Hathaway and Cruise will star in a new Days of Thunder film, Paramount Pictures and both stars announced on Saturday, Aug. 29.

Cruise will once again play NASCAR driver Cole Trickle, with Hathaway playing a team owner and engineer. The Top Gun: Maverick star is also producing with Jerry Bruckheimer and Tommy Harper.

Jonathan Levine is set to direct. His previous credits include Warm Bodies , 50/50 and Long Shot . He will direct from a script by Will Staples, who wrote the upcoming Chris Pratt drama Way of the Warrior Kid .

The new Days of Thunder will be filmed for IMAX and is scheduled to hit theaters on June 2, 2028.

Paramount also released a photo of Cruise, 64, and Hathaway, 43, together at Daytona International Speedway, leaning against a green racecar. Cruise and Hathaway also published a video on their social media pages to announce the project.

The original Days of Thunder was directed by Tony Scott and starred Cruise as a young racecar driver enlisted by a NASCAR team owner ( Randy Quaid ) to drive for him. Released in 1990, it also catapulted Nicole Kidman to international stardom and was her first on-screen pairing with Cruise.

Cruise, Paramount and Bruckheimer previously teamed up on a legacy sequel for 2022's Top Gun: Maverick , released 36 years after the original film. That movie earned over $1.5 billion and earned a Best Picture Oscar nomination. Cruise's partnership with Paramount also includes the Mission: Impossible franchise.

His next movie, Digger , a collaboration with filmmaker Alejandro G. Iñárritu , opens on Oct. 2.

This year has been one of the busiest in Hathaway's career. The Oscar winner has already starred in four movies released in 2026 – Mother Mary , The Devil Wears Prada 2 , The Odyssey and The End of Oak Street . Her fifth, Verity , opens on Oct. 2. She also stars in Ron Howard 's upcoming Alone at Dawn .

Hathaway is also set to work on The Princess Diaries 3 for Disney.

articles.title: Inesperada ruptura en el universo de ‘La isla de las tentaciones’: tan solo han durado tres meses
articles.standfirst: Uno de los protagonistas ha hecho pública la noticia con un comunicado
articles.summary: Uno de los protagonistas ha hecho pública la noticia con un comunicado
articles.body: El universo de ‘La isla de las tentaciones' es tan grande que muchas veces da lugar a parejas que combinan varias ediciones. Este es el caso de Nieves Tristán (23), tentadora VIP de la décima edición y concursante oficial junto con su expareja Lorenzo en la novena temporada, y Jesús (30), tentador de la octava entrega del famoso formato de Telecinco. Aunque se hizo oficial a mediados de mayo de este año, ambos habían comenzado antes una historia de amor intensa y que parecía ir viento en popa. Sin embargo, y de forma completamente inesperada, Jesús ha confirmado la ruptura. Lo ha hecho a través de un profundo y extenso comunicado que ha publicado en su perfil de Instagram. “Un día como hoy, el día de mi cumpleaños, nunca imaginé que tendría que explicar algo así. Hace unos días decidí poner fin a mi relación con Nieves. Sé que probablemente muchos os preguntaréis el porqué, así que prefiero adelantarme y explicarlo con sinceridad y desde el respeto”, comienza diciendo el escrito. El extentador asegura que “la realidad es mucho más sencilla de lo que quizá algunos puedan pensar” y señala que han sido dos personas que se han querido muchísimo, que han compartido momentos muy bonitos y que han vivido muchas cosas juntos”. El problema es que, “con el tiempo, nos hemos dado cuenta de que no terminábamos de encajar del todo”. “Tomé la decisión de dejar la relación porque creo que, a veces, querer a alguien también significa cuándo parar. Preferí quedarme con todo lo bonito que hemos vivido y con el cariño que nos tenemos antes de permitir que las cosas fueran a peor y terminar haciéndonos daño. Y para evitar rumores y malentendidos: no ha habido terceras personas, ni engaños, ni nada parecido. Simplemente, llegó un momento en el que entendí que lo mejor para los dos era tomar caminos diferentes”, sentencia Jesús.

articles.title: Fundraiser launched for The Kiwi Fruit is Cute crafting shop
articles.summary: "We don't want to give up, we want to keep making this work," say the owners.
articles.body:
Three best friends are fighting to keep their independent crafting shop alive amid a rise in business costs.

The Kiwi Fruit is Cute in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire, hosts charity events and hosts free community-drop in sessions.

When their previous home at Cavendish House was forced to close earlier this year , the shop moved to Lower High Street. Their new location means that overheads have "doubled" and they have since launched a crowdfunder to help cover these costs.

Siobhan Westmacott, one of the shop's founders, told BBC Radio Gloucestershire: "We are really in the position of trying really hard to make sure things can keep going month on month."

The shop is known for its Make & Mingle sessions, which see people travel from far and wide with their own projects to knit, sew or craft in a group rather than complete the tasks at home alone.

Charities, such as Oscar's Community Corner, also use space in the shop for their own crafting projects.

Westmacott continued: "We are working other jobs and don't take a wage from the business at all, we put everything back in. We are personally pushing our own finances into it to try and keep things going.

"As much as the business is growing... it is a real struggle at the moment. We are in a difficult period.

"This [the fundraiser] is so we keep open and keep things inclusive and affordable."

The Kiwi Fruit is Cute, named after an old email address of Westmacott's, was also founded by Samantha Potter and Zarina Ismail.

Potter said: "We've been best friends for well over five years. We don't want to give up, we want to keep making this work."

The shop owners say the fundraiser will help place a core restock order, fill gaps on the shelves and give the shop some breathing room while sales continue to build.

"It is for the practical stuff that keeps the doors open," their crowdfunder says.

The Kiwi Fruit is Cute also has a charity application pending, but this is expected to take several months.

articles.title: Gary Owen Admits Cheating on Ex-Wife Kenya Duke
articles.summary: The comedian admits he cheated on ex-wife Kenya Duke, then explains why intimacy and communication with Brianna Johnson changed his outlook.
articles.body:
Gary Owen isn't pretending he was faithful during his first marriage. But the comedian says he doesn't plan on repeating those mistakes with his current wife, Brianna Johnson—and he says the difference comes down to what happens at home.

During his latest sit-down with DJ Vlad , Owen was confronted directly about cheating on his ex-wife, Kenya Duke. "You did cheat on your ex-wife," Vlad said. Owen didn't dodge it: "Oh, my God. A few times here and there. Yeah."

But when Vlad asked whether Owen and Johnson have an understanding about infidelity or expect complete monogamy, Owen was equally clear: "I expect to be 100% faithful."

Vlad immediately pressed him on why, pointing out that Owen is 53, spends significant time on the road, and regularly encounters women while touring. Owen said his lifestyle has changed—he doesn't spend his downtime hitting nightclubs and bars like he once did—but said the biggest difference is his relationship itself.

"The biggest difference between this marriage and my last marriage is like, we weren't intimate, right, at all," Owen said. "We had three times the last six years of our marriage."

Owen stressed that he wasn't putting the collapse of his sex life with Duke solely on her. "This isn't a knock on my ex-wife," he said. "The feeling was mutual. Like, we just weren't into each other. If we were, we would have been sleeping together."

He said the disconnect became particularly obvious when the two spent roughly five months sleeping in the same bed during the COVID era without being intimate. With Johnson, Owen said, "This one's different." He added, "I enjoy being intimate with her. I enjoy—I look forward to coming home."

Communication, Owen argued, has also changed. Rather than treating a partner's lack of interest in sex as an indefinite rejection, he said he and Johnson talk about when they can reconnect. "I'm just tired, babe. Tomorrow though, I'm all yours," Owen offered as an example, adding that having that conversation prevents uncertainty from building between partners. "It's really just—I know it sounds like—you say it's communication."

Owen responded, "It was nice hanging out and catching up."

Their divorce had previously spilled into public view through financial disputes, allegations of infidelity, and Owen's eventual estrangement from his older children. Owen later called that estrangement his "greatest failure."

articles.summary: Comedian Leanne Morgan says Hollywood lives in a "bubble" and reveals she pushed back on a cursing scene while filming with Reese Witherspoon.
articles.body: Comedian Leanne Morgan is calling out Hollywood for living in a "bubble." During a recent appearance on "The Women of Joy Show" podcast, the 60-year-old actress discussed the idea that Christian women don't consume media, with host, Maegan Waldrep Schwindling, saying they want "quality" content, but without "women in their panties shooting bows and arrows and all the things like it." "Honest to goodness, I think in the secular world, I think people, no, I think a lot of people don't want to see all that," she said. "I think a lot of people don't want to see all that, and I think they're in a bubble out there, and they think people want to see that, but they're not in the middle of the United States." She went on to give an example from when she was filming a movie with Reese Witherspoon and Will Ferrell, in which she played a Southern mother of four, who in the script was meant to curse in front of her children. FORMER DISNEY STAR DAVID HENRIE REJECTED 'SECULAR' HOLLYWOOD LIFESTYLE AFTER LIFE-CHANGING MONASTERY VISIT Morgan recalled telling the director that a Southern mother of four "wouldn't talk like that in front of these children." In that case, the director, Nick Stoller, told her, "You know better than I do, Leanne, and you do what you think is best." "So I think they think in their minds, 'Oh, everybody's talking like this, everybody wants this,' but I don't think the majority of people do," she said. "Or not in the south, especially when you're portraying southern characters. Or anywhere really." She also explained that growing up, no one in her family used swear words and while "it's okay if somebody else wants to use it," she doesn't care to use them herself. The comedian is now starring in the Netflix show, "Leanne," in which she portrays a Southern mother in her 50s who is rebuilding her life after her husband left her for a younger woman. articles.title: Vicariously hike the Appalachian in the gorgeous A Trail Tale
articles.summary: A Trail Tale is an interactive Appalachian trail journal inspired by Sierra point-and-click adventures and Oregon Trail.
articles.body: I used to be an avid hiker and would try to go backpacking a few times a year. I always dreamed of thru-hiking the Appalachian Trail, but life kind of got in the way. (Turns out jobs, wives, and children aren’t thrilled with the idea of you disappearing for three months.) But I’ve been longing to reconnect with my love of the outdoors and just recently took my kids on their first camping trip. So I discovered A Trail Tale at a really opportune time. It’s an interactive trail journal created by Andy Moliski with help from his brothers Adam and Alex. The various segments of the trail are rendered in beautiful pixel art reminiscent of a ‘90s Sierra point-and-click adventure. Alex recorded an equally gorgeous original score that combines nature sounds, acoustic guitar, strings, and even what sounds like clarinet. As you click through each day, you’re greeted with information about landmarks and a game-like UI that is partially inspired by titles like Oregon Trail. (Spoiler: nobody dies of dysentery in this one.) Clicking on Andy unfurls a menu of icons that offer details about the journey, his mental state, and even bits of poetry. There are even little icons for things that impact his fortitude and morale meters, like inclement weather or picturesque scenery. It’s insanely easy to just get lost in Andy’s journey for hours. And it’s making me wonder if I should get back out there and start tackling some more of the AT myself.

articles.title: Quem é MC Pipokinha, cantora de shows sensuais condenada pela Justiça | G1
articles.standfirst: Cantora foi condenada, junto com outras quatro pessoas, a pagar R$ 162,1 mil por danos morais coletivos após show em espaço público de Corumbá (MS).
articles.summary: Cantora foi condenada, junto com outras quatro pessoas, a pagar R$ 162,1 mil por danos morais coletivos após show em espaço público de Corumbá (MS).
articles.body:
MC Pipokinha — Foto: Divulgação / Facebook da artista

A Justiça condenou a cantora Doroth Helena de Sousa Alves, conhecida como MC Pipokinha, e outras quatro pessoas envolvidas na realização do evento “Esquenta do Magrão”, em Corumbá (MS), ao pagamento de R$ 162,1 mil por danos morais coletivos .

Segundo a decisão, MC Pipokinha fez uma apresentação com conteúdo sexual explícito em espaço público, assistida por adolescentes, incluindo jovens de cerca de 14 anos. ( entenda o que aconteceu )

Aos 28 anos, a cantora catarinense cresceu em Tubarão (SC) e atualmente mora em São Paulo. Ela ganhou destaque no funk de rua, estilo conhecido como “mandelão”, com letras ousadas e apresentações marcadas por movimentos sexuais e interação com o público.

Entre as músicas que ajudaram a projetar a cantora estão “Bota na Pipokinha”, “Eu sou a MC Pipokinha” e “Tira as Crianças da Sala”.

Em entrevista, a cantora já explicou que a proposta de seu trabalho é levar para o palco as histórias contadas nas músicas. “É como se a história fosse a música, e o que eu apresento no meu espetáculo fosse um teatro”, afirmou. Ela definiu o espetáculo como “um musical da putaria”.

Nos shows, dançarinos interagem com fãs que se voluntariam para participar, com tapas e movimentos pélvicos. Pipokinha costuma aparecer de coroa e se apresentar como “rainha da putaria”. As cenas, que a cantora afirma serem consentidas pelos fãs, repercutiram nas redes sociais.

A cantora tem contrato com a produtora de funk paulista Novo Império. O empresário Wagner Magalhães, o Vavá, é experiente em fenômenos no funk e dirigiu a carreira do MC Fioti na época do megahit "Bum bum tam tam" – tanto que é citado na música, no verso "'tipo como? tipo Vavazinho".

Nas redes sociais, Pipokinha alterna fotos provocantes com histórias de superação. Recentemente, mostrou o pai dirigindo um carro que ela deu de presente. "Meu 'veinho' tá de carro novo, obrigada, Deus", ela disse, chorando.

MC Pipokinha — Foto: Divulgação/Instagram da artista

O perfil de Pipokinha, cheio de vídeos de golpes sexuais dos dançarinos, foi derrubado Instagram. Em setembro de 2022 a empresa suspendeu a conta @pipokinhareal por violar as "diretrizes da comunidade sobre propostas de cunho sexual".

Ela entrou na Justiça de SP para retomar a conta e ainda pediu uma multa por danos morais de R$ 90 mil ao Facebook, dono do Instagram. O pedido de Pipokinha foi negado, mas ela pode recorrer.

A MC lamentava que tinha perdido mais de 510 mil seguidores na conta banida em setembro. Mesmo sem a vitória na Justiça, ela ganhou na prática: adotou a conta @pihrainha, onde já superou a base anterior, com 621 mil seguidores – e que também está fora do ar.

Outro golpe recente foi um chute acidental que Jonas Kaik, dançarino de Pipokinha, deu em uma fã em um show no dia 12 de janeiro, no meio da dança sensual. No Instagram, ele lamentou o acidente, disse que ela foi atendida imediatamente e estava bem.

Depois de a fã ser socorrida (e de ficar "tudo tranquilo, tudo em paz" com ela, segundo Kaik), o acidente só fez aumentar a curiosidade sobre o show de Pipokinha. Desde o dia 12 de janeiro, ela aparece frequentemente entre os assuntos mais comentados do Twitter no Brasil.

Em 2023, a cantora teve ao menos sete shows cancelados após fazer um vídeo em que debocha do salário de professores . Na época, ela perdeu apresentações no Rio Grande do Norte, Santa Catarina, Distrito Federal, Espírito Santo, Rondônia, Minas Gerais e São Paulo.

MC Pipokinha debochou do trabalho e dos salários dos professores em resposta a um fã no Instagram, que tinha contado que discutiu com uma professora por causa da funkeira.

"Ser professora tem que amar muito a profissão, porque ouve desaforo dos filhos dos outros, tem nada pra fazer em casa mesmo, tem que ser professora. E ainda receber o que um professor recebe, que é quase nada. Professor é humilhado pra c... só de ser um professor", afirmou a funkeira.

E completou: "Meu baile está R$ 70 mil: 30 minutinhos no palco, eu ganho R$ 70 mil. Ela não ganha nem R$ 5 mil sendo professora às vezes. Precisa estudar muito".

Após a repercussão negativa da fala e de ter vários shows cancelados, a equipe jurídica da cantora se pronunciou dizendo que ela 'se expressou de maneira dúbia' .

A equipe jurídica da cantora afirma que ela "infelizmente, vem sofrendo inúmeros ataques gratuitos na internet, em razão de ser atuante em questões de empoderamento feminino e por estar em constante crescimento na mídia, e ao ouvir palavras supostamente ditas por outra mulher, se expressou de maneira dúbia, dando assim, chance para interpretações pejorativas e que foram distorcidas de sua real intenção".

Além dos lançamentos musicais e dos shows, Pipokinha também vende fotos e vídeos sensuais na Privacy, uma plataforma brasileira de venda de nudes, concorrente do Only Fans.

articles.title: Seu Jorge em Bonito: cantor elogia público e planeja volta a MS | G1
articles.standfirst: Cantor se apresentou no Festival de Inverno de Bonito neste sábado (29) e disse que quer retornar ao estado para conhecer os atrativos naturais com a mulher e o filho.
articles.summary: Seu Jorge elogiou o público do Festival de Inverno de Bonito e revelou planos de retornar ao Mato Grosso do Sul para curtir o ecoturismo da região com sua família.
articles.body:
Seu Jorge se apresenta no Festival de Inverno de Bonito, na noite deste sábado (29). — Foto: Reprodução/TV Morena

Seu Jorge se encantou com a recepção do público de Mato Grosso do Sul durante o Festival de Inverno de Bonito , na noite deste sábado (29). Depois do show, o cantor conversou com a equipe da Rede Matogrossense de Comunicação, classificou o encontro com os sul-mato-grossenses como “algo muito raro de se encontrar” e prometeu voltar ao estado com a família.

Sem tempo para conhecer os atrativos de Bonito nesta passagem, o artista contou que pretende retornar com a mulher e o filho, Samba, de 3 anos.

“Lamento não poder fazer esse ecoturismo, porque eu gostaria de voltar com a minha senhora e com o meu menino e aproveitar isso com mais tempo e com eles também. Viver essa experiência junto.”

Para Seu Jorge, a viagem seria também uma oportunidade de criar novas lembranças com o filho.

“Agora o Samba está com três anos de idade e qualquer coisinha dessas é uma coleção de memórias. Eu quero viver o inédito, a experiência inédita com eles sempre.”

O público foi um dos pontos que mais chamou a atenção do cantor. Seu Jorge brincou com o calor em pleno Festival de Inverno e elogiou a energia que encontrou diante do palco.

“O encontro aqui foi bonito, foi lindíssimo. [...] Mesmo que tivesse [frio], o calor humano que eu encontrei hoje nessa plateia foi algo muito raro de se encontrar.”

Ele também destacou a mistura de gerações que acompanhou o show, da juventude aos mais velhos. “Você via a juventude, você via os maduros, você via a segunda juventude também presente.”

Após o show, Seu Jorge conversou com a TV Morena e elogiou a recepção do público sul-mato-grossense — Foto: Reprodução/TV Morena

No fim da apresentação, Seu Jorge ainda surpreendeu o público ao retornar ao palco para cantar novamente “Mina do Condomínio”, música que abriu o show.

Na entrevista, ele explicou que não havia ficado satisfeito com a primeira performance, quando ainda não estava totalmente aquecido. Mesmo com o horário do show chegando ao fim, decidiu tentar de novo.

“Eu falei: ‘Não, isso não pode ficar assim. Eu vou ter que voltar lá e fazer melhor’, porque eu já estava melhor.”

Seu Jorge também confirmou que pretende voltar a Bonito não apenas para trabalhar, mas para aproveitar a região com a família.

“Sim, claro, volto. E volto não só para tocar, mas volto para prestigiar a região, porque essa é uma das regiões muito virtuosas do Brasil naquilo que diz respeito ao turismo e ao ecoturismo.”

Ao falar sobre Bonito, o cantor ainda definiu o Brasil como uma “potência ecológica” e ressaltou a importância da preservação.

“A natureza é um negócio muito importante. Muitas das vezes nos falta para essa vida competitiva, cada vez mais urbana. E aí aqui isso ainda se respira.”

O show de Seu Jorge foi realizado no penúltimo dia do Festival de Inverno de Bonito. A programação termina neste domingo (30).

articles.title: Grupo carioca Gafieirando saúda Paulo Moura e Zé da Velha em álbum que traz a voz de Guinga no 'Bolero de Satã' | G1
articles.body:
Capa do álbum 'Gafieirando', do grupo carioca Gafieirando — Foto: Micael Hocherman / Divulgação

♬ Compositor imortalizado pelos grandes e amargurados sambas-canção que legou à música brasileira, o gaúcho Lupicínio Rodrigues (1914 – 1974) está duplamente representado no repertório do álbum de estreia do grupo carioca Gafieirando.

O samba “Se acaso você chegasse” (Lupicínio Rodrigues e Felisberto Martins, 1938) e o samba-canção “Nunca” (1952) integram o repertório de “Gafieirando”, álbum que tem lançamento programado para 18 de setembro com capa que expõe o grupo em foto de Micael Hocherman.

No álbum, editado pelo gravadora Kuarup, o grupo – liderado pela flautista e saxofonista Daniela Spielmann, doutora em música com pesquisa dedicada às gafieiras cariocas – tem a intenção de atiçar a memória afetiva dos bailes da cidade do Rio de Janeiro (RJ).

Com a voz da cantora Alana Moraes e os sopros da flauta de Alexandre Romanazzi e do trompete de Silvério Pontes, o grupo afieirando traz para o salão músicas como “Bolero de Satã” (Guinga e Paulo César Pinheiro, 1976) – ouvido nas vozes de Alana e do próprio Guinga – e “Olha eu aqui oh oh oh” (Roberto Corrêa e Jon Lemos, 1974), sucesso da cantora Evinha na década de 1970.

Completado pelos músicos Antonio Guerra (teclados e sanfona), Domingos Teixeira (violão e guitarra), Rodrigo Scofield (bateria) e Rodrigo Villa (contrabaixo), o grupo Gafieirando apresenta duas músicas inéditas no álbum – “Do balacobaco” (Sombra) e “Todo santo dia” (Chico Alves e Mauro Aguiar) – entre temas em homenagem ao trombonista Zé da Velha (1941 – 2025), celebrado em “O trombone do Zé” (Silvério Pontes e Daniela Spielmann), e ao clarinetista Paulo Moura (1932 – 2006), saudado com “Clarinete do Moura” (Silvério Pontes e Daniela Spielmann).

O repertório do álbum “Gafieirando” também inclui abordagens das músicas “Fibra” (Paulo Moura e Eloir de Moraes, 1971), “Gafieira carioca” (Zé Menezes) e “Reencontro” (Silvério Pontes).

Como o Gafieirando surgiu da expansão do Daniela Spielmann Trio, grupo formado em 2016, os músicos consideram que o álbum celebra os 10 anos de atuação do coletivo na cena carioca.

articles.title: Country duo Dan + Shay nearly broke up at height of success when their communication faltered
articles.summary: Dan + Shay reveal the late-night conversation at Dan Smyers' home that saved their partnership after a 2021 communication breakdown nearly ended it all.
articles.body: Country music duo Dan + Shay revealed they almost went their separate ways at the height of their success. The duo, composed of Dan Smyers, 39, and Shay Mooney, 34, admitted while on the "Artist Friendly" podcast recently that, at the pinnacle of their success, "there was unhealthy dynamics between both of us 'cause we process things a lot differently." Mooney explained that their biggest issue was that there "was just a communication stop," and they eventually "got to this point" where it was "just getting really tough." "We had that moment in 2021, and it was kind of like, all right, do we ride off into the sunset and celebrate our accomplishments or do, like, we have some maybe really hard conversations with each other and fix this?" Mooney said. COUNTRY STAR STEPS AWAY FROM MUSIC TO FOCUS ON HIMSELF AFTER FAME TOOK A TOLL After host Joel Madden pressed the duo for more details, Smyers explained that, after they landed the opening slot for Kenny Chesney's tour, they were excited but didn't know if they could do it since their relationship was in a bad place. They ultimately decided, "We have to figure this out," even if it meant that they "call it a day and go out on this Kenny tour as our farewell tour," Smyers said. The two decided to meet at Smyers' home to have a conversation, with Smyers calling that meeting "the most pivotal critical moment in our entire career." "We're either going to say peace out to this thing or we're going to figure this out and get it right," Mooney said. articles.title: Google Maps lo confirma: este es el motivo por el que no debería usar el camino más corto en horas puntas
articles.standfirst: La plataforma tiene en cuenta la recomendación del resto de aplicaciones similares
articles.summary: La plataforma tiene en cuenta la recomendación del resto de aplicaciones similares
articles.body: A los ciudadanos que viajan en coche diariamente, hay pocas situaciones que les molestan más que un atasco o una retención. La gran mayoría, rápidamente, busca rutas alternativas en aplicaciones como Google Maps o Waze. El problema es que todos los conductores ‘atrapados’ en esta congestión suelen buscar las mismas soluciones. Si todos los conductores se dejan guiar por estas aplicaciones y toman carreteras menos congestionadas, al final se llega a la misma: si cientos de teléfonos móviles hacen lo mismo, estas arterias dejan de ser rápidas porque se colapsan. Un estudio llevado a cabo por Google y publicado en Nature Cities, deja entrever que usar el camino más corto ha dejado de ser una opción muy favorable. Lo que hizo Google fue aplicar una penalización a los segmentos de carretera que presentaban el peor desempeño durante las horas de mayor congestión. De este modo, el sistema de enrutamiento buscara otras rutas alternativas que ofrecieran características similares en cuanto al tipo de vía y un tiempo de viaje comparable. Una vez completado este paso, Google analizó cómo este cambio afectó al comportamiento del tráfico en el conjunto de la red vial durante los días laborables, tomando como referencia el periodo comprendido entre las 7:00 de la mañana y las 8:00 de la noche. Pues bien, esto se traduce en que el ahorro de tiempo conseguido es muy reducido cuando tomamos otras alternativas: apenas un 0,25% de la duración del viaje. El beneficio fue aproximadamente cuarenta veces menor que las variaciones habituales que experimenta una misma ruta de un día para otro. Para comprenderlo, la diferencia era tan pequeña que los conductores de las diez ciudades analizadas prácticamente no pudieron percibir ningún cambio en sus tiempos de viaje. Y es que parece que la mejor solución es quedarse a merced del tráfico durante un atasco y dejar de tomar rutas alternativas.

articles.title: Samay Raina sparks fresh controversy with Bihar-Kashmir banter on 'India's Got Latent 2'; political leaders REACT: 'Just stick to comedy'
articles.summary: Comedian Samay Raina is once again at the centre of a controversy after his banter with fellow comedian Sharon Verma on 'India's Got Latent 2' trigger.
articles.body: Comedian Samay Raina is once again at the centre of a controversy after his banter with fellow comedian Sharon Verma on 'India's Got Latent 2' triggered widespread criticism. It drew sharp reactions from political leaders across party lines over jokes touching on regional and community sentiments.What happened on Samay Raina'a showIn the recent episode, Sharon Verma, a former contestant from the show's first season, appeared as a panellist alongside Samay, Orry, Archana Puran Singh, and Nishant Suri. During the exchange, Raina took a dig at Verma's Bihari roots and stereotypes around migration for work. Verma responded by joking about his Kashmiri identity and "getting stoned", further quipping that she had "at least left her state by choice."While the banter appeared to be mutual and light-hearted on screen, with both comedians seemingly enjoying the exchange, clips from the episode soon triggered strong reactions online and caught the attention of political leaders, reigniting the debate around insensitive humour.Shiv Sena (UBT) slams Samay RainaSpeaking to ANI, Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Anand Dubey strongly criticised the comedian. He said, "Samay Raina is a comedian. His comedy routines often feature a great deal of obscenity. He has been involved in numerous controversies before; he has always been a controversial figure... But Samay Raina has just made another controversial statement. His recent altercation with another comedian, Sharon Verma, reveals a profound lack of understanding on their part. These people will stoop to any level just to make money. Samay Raina understands neither Bihar nor Jammu and Kashmir properly. Although he hails from Jammu and Kashmir, he shows no loyalty to that region, and certainly none to the people of Bihar... Just stick to comedy. Why drag specific castes, states, or religions into it?"Bihar minister calls remarks 'intolerable'Bihar Education Minister Mithilesh Tiwari also weighed in, telling media, "Any derogatory remark against any citizen of our country is intolerable; those who make such comments are essentially talking about tearing the nation apart. We envision an undivided India; for us, the king and the commoner are equal, and there should be no discrimination in the country based on caste or creed. This is the clear stance of the BJP."Mixed reactions from other leadersShiv Sena leader Sanjay Nirupam offered a more nuanced take, saying, "Samay Raina's show is a comedy show, and I believe humour should be taken as humour. I know the remark related to Bihar wasn't good, and the way the girl connected to Bihar gave a sharp retort in the context of Kashmir didn't sit well with me either... The atrocities committed against Kashmiri Pandits – she, in some way, commented on those atrocities, and Samay Raina, who is a Kashmiri Pandit, was clapping for it. That didn't sit well with me either... I felt like the injustice faced by Kashmiri Pandits was being mocked, but in the end, I forgive both those kids. It was humour, and it should be taken as a joke... There is no place for obscenity in society. If someone spreads obscenity in the name of humour, then certainly there should be a ban on them."Congress leader Harish Rawat added, "Humour is a divine art form that uplifts people, gladdens the heart, and lightens the burden of worries. However, when you misuse it to portray a caste, community, or region in a derogatory or mocking manner, it diminishes the value of humour itself. Samay Raina needs to understand this."AAP leader Sanjay Singh took a more forgiving stance, stating, "I think that if a comedian says something like this, their intention is to make people laugh. In that process, sometimes they make mistakes. But I think it is not right to turn it into an issue and target them. Instead, one should engage in dialogue with them and explain."BJP leaders demand stricter lawsBJP MLA RS Pathania condemned the remarks strongly, saying, "India has a collective flow, a collective sentiment; India has a history, India has a tradition, and India has a golden future. Mischievous acts like this have previously led to fines for Samay Raina, but by tearing apart the guidelines set by law, the Constitution, and social ethics, he has made the remark again. We condemn it."PDP leader Syed Tajamul Islam stressed the need for sensitivity towards Kashmiri Pandits, saying, "The land of Jammu & Kashmir remains incomplete without (Kashmiri Pandits)... They did not leave their homes out of mere choice. The way these personalities are sometimes treated, there is no room for such conduct in either religion or humanity... We await their return, but wherever they are, they deserve great respect."Congress leader Tariq Anwar remarked, "We are civilised citizens of India. People are born in different places. While speaking, one should keep in mind that no one's feelings are hurt."BJP leader Ram Kadam went further, calling for legal action against such content. He said, "We all respect any artist's talent, his art, but if under the guise of art, someone's faith, belief, or sentiments are hurt, it simply means that the artist is crossing certain boundaries to cause pain to people. Now this has become a trend. For publicity stunts, people start dragging in gods and goddesses or sentiments... It all ends with an apology... Now the time has come to enact a strict law against this... Then no one will have the courage to do such things. Enacting a strict law is the need of the hour, but until such a law is made, the public should ban such people on social media so that their minds come to their senses... Whether it's Samay Raina or anyone else under the guise of art, no one's sentiments can be hurt, and if someone is doing that, they cannot be forgiven."No response yet from Samay Raina or Sharon VermaAs political and public reactions continue to mount, both Samay Raina and Sharon Verma are yet to issue a public statement addressing the criticism surrounding the episode. This is not the first time Raina's show has landed him in controversy, with the comedian having previously faced backlash and fines over content on his platform.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: 'Saaho' turns 7: Chunky Panday recalls FIRST encounter with 'Baahubali' star Prabhas; 'Met him like fan literally'- Exclusive
articles.summary: As Prabhas and Shraddha Kapoor starrer 'Saaho' completes seven years of its release, Chunky Panday looks back at the action thriller and his experienc.
articles.body: As Prabhas and Shraddha Kapoor starrer 'Saaho' completes seven years of its release, Chunky Panday looks back at the action thriller and his experience of playing the menacing Devraj aka Deva, a character that required him to undergo a dramatic physical transformation. In an exclusive conversation, the actor opened up about why he agreed to play the negative role, working with Prabhas after 'Baahubali', shooting extensively in Hyderabad, and the one scene that genuinely disturbed him.Panday recalls that director Sujeeth initially surprised him by wanting to cast him as the main villain opposite Prabhas, who was riding high on the success of 'Baahubali'. The actor assumed the filmmaker had seen his popular comedy 'Aankhen', but Sujeeth had a very different reference point.“I remember when I signed 'Saaho', the director had come to meet me. And the only film he had seen of mine was 'Aankhen'. So I said, Wow, you've seen 'Aankhen'; you want to cast me as the main villain of your film? And that even opposite Prabhas, who's coming after 'Baahubali'. So he said, no, I saw another film of yours called 'Begum Jaan'.”“He says you were very scary in that. So I think you'll do a great job in my film.”Chunky Panday went unrecognized in 'Saaho'For the character, Panday grew a white beard and had his hair completely buzzed off. The director was clear that he did not want the audience to immediately recognize the actor behind the villain.“So there we went. I grew my beard, a white beard. And then, you know, he buzzed my hair completely. And he says, I don't want people to know this is Chunky Pandey. And I said, Are you sure? And he said, "Yep." And there I was.”The transformation worked so well that some viewers only realized they had been watching Chunky Panday after the film ended.“In fact, I was; you know, after the movie, there were a lot of people who called me after the film who realized it was me when the film got over. So I think for me, that's the biggest victory for an actor. Where people can actually go into a film and watch it and not realize that you're actually watching this actor.” ‘My wife always said I was a villain.'While Panday has been known for his comic timing and easy-going personality, 'Saaho' was another opportunity for him to explore darker characters. Asked what drew him towards playing negative roles, the actor had a typically humorous answer.“See, my wife always said I was a villain. Every wife says, "You're a real-life villain." When there's a fight. I wanted to prove her right.”Panday has since explored several shades of gray and outright negative characters, including his role in 'Begum Jaan', 'Saaho', the Tamil film 'Sardar', and the second season of Kunal Kemmu's 'Abhay'.“I played a couple of villain characters. I played 'Begum Jaan' and I played 'Saho'. Then I did a very big hit Tamil film. The sequel is releasing next week.”Talking about 'Sardar', he adds, “That was a hit film. There again I played; there was a lot of variation. Because I played from the age of 25 to 75."He also remembers his particularly unusual character in 'Abhay 2': “I played a villain, a very crazy villain. In a show of Kunal Khemu, which he did. God, It was a very nice show.”“In the second season where I played this crazy character. Who eats the brains of little children. Because he wants to become intelligent. So yeah, I played this crazy. It took us two years to do that film."Playing Devraj came with its own set of challenges, particularly because 'Saaho' was shot as a bilingual film. Panday had to deliver his lines in Telugu, while the team also shot Hindi portions.“You know the challenging part was. It must have been mentally as well. You know, it was. I mean, of course, you know mouthing the Telugu lines.”“But you'll be surprised. A lot, for a lot of the Hindi takes also. He kept my Telugu takes. And made me dub over the Telugu take. So it was bilingual. We used to shoot it in Hindi. And then we used to shoot it in Telugu.”Once he became comfortable with the process, Panday found himself slipping naturally into the character.“But you know, then once I got into the flow. I kind of got used to this. You know the whole atmosphere. Shooting in Hyderabad. You know in the film city in Hyderabad. All the sets created out there. I actually got into this character very easily.”“I was surprised. And it took us two years to do that film. So I kept going in and out of that look. It was quite crazy.”Saaho forced Chunky to wear a wig in 'Housefull 4'The drastic look for Saaho even created a continuity challenge when Panday moved on to Housefull 4.“In fact, I remember once I was just finishing the film. And then I had to start 'Housefull 4'. And my hair had not grown back. Because it was. And Vasta has very long hair.” “So in Housefull 4 I had to wear a wig.," he revealed.When asked whether 'Saaho' was the reason, he confirmed, “I had to wear it because of. This movie. Because of 'Saaho'.”The 'Saaho' scene that disturbed Chunky PandayDespite the scale of the film, it was one particular scene that stayed with Panday long after filming. He recalls the moment when his character attacks his own father, played by Tinu Anand.“You know that portion in Saaho. Where I choke my father at the conference table. I grab his neck. And start choking. Tinu Anand. That was something. That even disturbed me when I did it.”The scene, according to Panday, was an indication of just how dark his character could get.Meeting Prabhas after 'Baahubali'Working with Prabhas was another major highlight for Panday. Saaho came at a time when the actor had become a pan-India phenomenon following the enormous success of 'Baahubali 2: The Conclusion'.“He's always been larger than life. I mean after 'Baahubali'. And this was after 'Baahubali 2'. So he had gone to another level altogether. And I was super excited to meet him. When I met him the first time. I met him like a fan literally.”But Panday says Prabhas quickly made him feel at ease and his hospitality was unforgettable.“And he said he has watched so many of my movies. But I'll tell you he was such a fantastic host. Every time I went and shot for the film, I used to put 2 kilos and come back. Because he used to get all food cooked from his home.”“And he used to get this really great Andhra food. And we used to pig out. One day I remember I ate so much. I had to go to sleep after lunch.”“So yeah. It's been like that. He was a great host. I really enjoyed filming with him.”For Panday, 'Saaho' was also significant because it marked one of his major outings in the South Indian film industry. The scale of the project made the experience even more memorable.“There was Shraddha in the film. There was Tinu. And you know it was. This was something I never attempted. I had not done anything in the south. Then I get to do the biggest film in the south.”Shooting in Hyderabad also gave him a chance to meet several familiar faces from the Hindi film industry who were working on other projects in the city.“I mean, of course. When we were shooting out there. In Hyderabad. At the film city. There were so many other Hindi speakers. Projects going on. So I used to keep going on to different sets. And meeting people. And it was so strange.”Despite being away from Mumbai, Panday says the 'Saaho' team made him feel completely at home.“But I will tell you. The unit made me feel absolutely at home. I loved it. I used to wait to go back to shoot for 'Saaho'. Because they used to thoroughly pamper me.”For the actor, the scale and technical ambition of 'Saaho' also offered a new learning experience.“And it was great work. Because it was the first time I had seen it. So much green screen being used. And special effects. And grand sets. And the director himself was quite a visionary. So I really enjoyed it. Young director he is. It was fun.”Give your child the gift of confidence! Claim your exclusive TOI Masterclass spot today!
